from_quote: the concurrence of two thirds of the Senate will be requisite to a condemnation
rationale: Says "the concurrence of two thirds of the Senate will be requisite to a condemnation," echoing this clause's "Concurrence of two thirds of the Members present."
to_quote: no Person shall be convicted without the Concurrence of two thirds of the Members present

from_quote: is to have concurrent authority with the Executive in the formation of treaties and in the appointment to offices
rationale: Restates the objectors' account that the Senate "is to have concurrent authority with the Executive in the formation of treaties and in the appointment to offices," the two powers this clause makes subject to the Senate's advice and consent.

from_quote: The exclusive privilege of originating money bills will belong to the House of Representatives
rationale: Names the House's "exclusive privilege of originating money bills" as a provision of the plan, echoing this clause's "shall originate in the House of Representatives."
to_quote: All Bills for raising Revenue shall originate in the House of Representatives

from_quote: The same house will possess the sole right of instituting impeachments
rationale: Says the House "will possess the sole right of instituting impeachments," echoing this clause's "sole Power of Impeachment."
to_quote: shall have the sole Power of Impeachment

from_quote: The same house will be the umpire in all elections of the President, which do not unite the suffrages of a majority of the whole number of electors
rationale: Names the House's part in elections of the President that lack "a majority of the whole number of electors," echoing this clause's "a Majority of the whole Number of Electors appointed."
to_quote: a Majority of the whole Number of Electors appointed

from_quote: It will be the office of the President to NOMINATE, and, with the advice and consent of the Senate, to APPOINT
rationale: Restates the appointment power in this clause's own words, "to NOMINATE, and, with the advice and consent of the Senate, to APPOINT."
to_quote: he shall nominate, and by and with the Advice and Consent of the Senate, shall appoint

from_quote: The JOINT AGENCY of the Chief Magistrate of the Union, and of two thirds of the members of a body selected by the collective wisdom of the legislatures of the several States
rationale: Describes the security the Constitution provides in the formation of treaties as the "JOINT AGENCY" of the President and "two thirds" of the Senate, echoing this clause's "provided two thirds of the Senators present concur."
to_quote: provided two thirds of the Senators present concur
